item.title: Vinesh Phogat Flays WFI For Not Allowing Nirmala Boora To Take Part In National Trials
item.description: Haryana MLA Vinesh Phogat: Olympian wrestler and Haryana MLA Vinesh Phogat has taken the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) to task for treating seasoned grappler Nirmala Boora "extremely unfairly" during the recent national trials. She claimed that Nirmala was not allowed to participate in the trials, and no reason was given for denying her the opportunity.

item.title: ‘Stay In Your Domain’: Gambhir Slams ‘IPL Team Owner’ After ODI Series Win
item.description: Gautam Gambhir: Team India head coach Gautam Gambhir, under scrutiny following the recent Test series defeat to South Africa, delivered a fiery rebuttal to critics after India clinched the ODI series 2–1 with a dominant nine-wicket victory over the Proteas in the third and final match of the series in Visakhapatnam on Saturday.

item.title: AIFF Super Cup Final: Old Rivals East Bengal, FC Goa Eye Another Crown
item.description: AFC Champions League Two: Having clashed many times over the last few years, East Bengal and FC Goa will be no strangers with each other's players and tactics when they meet in the final of the AIFF Super Cup 2025-26. The winners of the past two editions, East Bengal FC and FC Goa, will meet in the summit clash at the PJN Stadium in Fatorda, Goa, on Sunday.

item.title: NZ Add Uncapped Pacer Michael Rae To Squad For Second Test Against WI
item.description: The West Indies: New Zealand have added uncapped fast bowler Michael Rae to the Test squad for the second match against the West Indies, starting on December 10 in Wellington.

item.title: Rivaan Dev Preetham Impresses With Two Top 10 Finishes In Bahrain
item.description: Rotax Max Challenge Grand Finals: India’s Rivaan Dev Preetham delivered two top-10 performances in the highly competitive Rotax Max Challenge Grand Finals, which concluded at the Bahrain International Circuit, here on Saturday.

item.title: ACA Chair Paul Marsh ‘refreshed’ By Cricket Australia’s Take On Khawaja’s Perth Pitch Comments
item.description: Australian Cricketers Association: Paul Marsh, the current head of the Australian Cricketers Association (ACA), expressed that he was ‘refreshed’ by Cricket Australia's response to Usman Khawaja's remark about the Perth pitch for the Ashes opener.

item.title: Messi's Inter Miami CF Crowned MLS Cup Champions
item.description: Inter Miami CF: Inter Miami CF secured a historic 3-1 win over Vancouver Whitecaps FC to clinch the Club’s fourth trophy and first-ever MLS Cup title.

item.title: Namibia Appoint Gary Kirsten As Consultant Ahead Of 2026 T20 WC
item.description: ICC Cricket World Cup: Former India head coach Gary Kirsten has been appointed as a consultant for the Namibian men’s cricket team ahead of the T20 World Cup 2026, which will take place in India and Sri Lanka in February-March.

item.title: Torres' Hat-trick Powers Barcelona Past Betis In La Liga
item.description: La Liga: Ferran Torres scored a first-half hat-trick as FC Barcelona roared back from conceding an early goal to beat Real Betis 5-3 in La Liga.

item.title: Nissanka, Vince power Gulf Giants to second straight win and top of ILT20 table
item.description: Pathum Nissanka’s explosive 67 and James Vince’s unbeaten fifty powered Gulf Giants to a four-wicket win over Dubai Capitals in ILT20 Season 4. Azmatullah Omarzai starred with 3/46 as Giants chased 161 to go top of the points table.
